profile.name: Andrea Micola Azwir

hero.intro: I’m Andrea, a frontend engineer building web and mobile apps, with a background in data analysis.
hero.status: Currently building at PT Inovasi Jelajah Dunia

about.heading: Good work starts
paragraphs: I like understanding how things work, then figuring out how to make them work better.

I’m a frontend engineer at PT Inovasi Jelajah Dunia, where I build the company’s travel eSIM mobile app and website with React Native, Next.js, and TypeScript. I graduated in Informatics from Malikussaleh University in 2024, and a background in data analysis still shapes how I think about products.
From freelance projects to product teams, I care about the details that make an application feel clear and easy to use.

projects.title: An office you can explore.
projects.name: Kantor Kita
projects.description: An interactive four-floor virtual office for a 13-person team. Explore the building, follow team routines, and manage tasks from the office interface.

projects.title: Where to stay, and how to get there.
projects.name: SIG Penginapan Banda Aceh
projects.description: A geographic information system that ranks accommodation in Banda Aceh with Multi-Attribute Utility Theory, then finds the shortest route from your location to the chosen place with the A* algorithm.

projects.title: A folk tale you can play.
projects.name: Si Kancil: Petualangan di Kampung
projects.stack: TypeScript · HTML5 Canvas · Web Audio · Capacitor
projects.description: A 2D platformer inspired by the Si Kancil folk tale, playable in the browser and on Android. Run through four levels, cross the river on crocodiles' backs, and listen to a gamelan soundtrack. Every sprite and sound is generated in code.

projects.title: Plan the trip, then book it.
projects.name: OTEWE Travel Agency
projects.description: A travel agency website with a 3D island on the home page, destination search and filters, package pages with a gallery and booking requests, and a travel journal. An admin dashboard manages packages, articles, and booking status.

projects.title: A farm crew that takes orders.
projects.name: Crew & Crop
projects.description: A 3D farming game prototype inspired by Hay Day. Give the crew orders in plain English and Claude turns them into standing rules for three farmers, settles problems like a fallen tree or a full barn, and writes their daily diary. The game engine handles movement, stock, and time.

bullets: Develop and maintain features for the company’s consumer mobile app on iOS and Android using React Native, Expo, and TypeScript, covering onboarding, account management, and purchase-to-activation flows with multi-language support.
Build and maintain the company website with Next.js and React, creating responsive, SEO-friendly pages that display product and pricing data from the backend API.
Turn Figma designs into reusable components and keep the interface consistent across mobile and web, iterating on feedback from design reviews.
Work with design and backend teams to integrate APIs, manage server data with React Query, and add analytics tracking for key user actions.
Design and build web applications that support data analysis and decision-making, with attention to performance and accessibility.
Work directly with clients to define requirements, design intuitive interfaces, and structure data management for each project.
Deliver responsive, user-friendly web applications tailored to each client’s needs and context.

Monitored and managed trouble tickets from multiple tower providers (TBG, TIS/IBS, Persada Sokka, Smartfren) across Sumatra and Kalimantan, with 100% compliance on monitoring and on-time closing under SLAs from emergency cases (2-hour SLA) to minor issues (7-day SLA).

Coordinated field team responses across 5 regions through the TOTI system, applied systematic escalation from Supervisor to General Manager level, and monitored teams in real time via GPS coordinates.
Maintained evidence databases for completed tickets and managed reporting with 100% accuracy for Telkomsel, XL, Smartfren, and Indosat.
Supported the internal audit team in reviewing financial reports for compliance with applicable accounting standards.
Analyzed financial and non-financial data to identify discrepancies and operational inefficiencies, supporting better decision-making.
Collected and validated supporting documents such as invoices, bank statements, and transaction records to keep the audit complete.
Cleaned and prepared data with spreadsheets, SQL, R, and Tableau to produce accurate, analysis-ready datasets.
Designed interactive dashboards that present data clearly for data-driven decisions.
Applied R and Tableau for data management and visualization.
Built responsive user interfaces with React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, and Tailwind CSS in web development projects.
Applied Object-Oriented Programming principles for structured code and managed projects with Git and GitHub.
Used Node.js to build backend functionality that integrates with the frontend.
